liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review): Jerry and Brent both rip on Watchtower; a gem in the Dylan set [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-07-04.sbd.miller.101650.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 190 min; rated 3.4/5 by 15 [1]
- **gd1987-07-04.143052.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 28 songs; 194 min [2]
- **gd1987-07-04.143049.dts.tobin.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 28 songs; 194 min [3]
- **gd1987-07-04.143048.mtx.tobin.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 28 songs; 194 min [4]
- **gd1987-07-04.senn.lai.30370.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 29 songs; 179 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [8]. Said about its sound: Dylan sings within the Dead groove; Jerry still relearning rhythm [14]
- **gd1987-07-04.sbd-set2.unknown.97513.shnf**: soundboard; 13 songs; 74 min; rated 4.17/5 by 6 [12]. Said about its sound: Dylan sounds more sober than on the official Dylan and the Dead album [15]

## Around the show

- Sullivan Stadium was hot; listener squished between overweight fans outside [18]
- Ninety-degree temps, humidity, gate crashing, drunk idiots, and terrible cops [19]
- Listener left early due to parking lot traffic; listened to last tunes from car [20]
- Worst traffic and 90+ degree wait; friend passed ticket through fence to fan [21]
- Disgustingly hot, muggy, grossly crowded, backed up, and riddled with cops [23]
- Listener notes four John Brown songs and Frankie Lee in the recording [24]
- Crowd thinned for Dylan; listener and buddy were way down front sweating [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-07-04.sbd.miller.101650.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> CD [1]. Also: Set 2 songs sung by Dylan; Jerry on Pedal Steel for I'll Be Your Baby Tonight [1]
- **gd1987-07-04.143052.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: flac16/48kHz ; 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound (48k) - SBD (shnid = 101650) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> Samplitude Professional… [2]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user; FLAC conversion on 30-AUG-2018 [2]
- **gd1987-07-04.143049.dts.tobin.flac1644**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix; ; SBD (shnid = 101650) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> FLAC; All… [3]. Also: DTS-Audio-CD format; requires digital cable connection for playback [3]
- **gd1987-07-04.143048.mtx.tobin.flac1644**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid = 101650) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> FLAC; All… [4]
- **gd1987-07-04.senn.lai.30370.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai; source: OB> aud> senn me80> cassette master> cdr [8]
